uz:
🎯 Omadli zarba
Oq shar bilan oltin sharni nishon markaziga yuboring! Har kuni bepul urinish bor, sharlar va nishon har safar yangi joyda chiqadi.
en:
🎯 Lucky Shot
Send the golden ball to the bullseye with the cue ball! There is a free try every day, and the balls and the target land in a new place every time.

uz:
🌆 Har shaharning o'z stoli
30 shahar, har birining o'ziga xos stoli: London, Madrid, Dubay va boshqalar. Qaysi stollarni ochdingiz?
en:
🌆 A table for every city
30 cities, each with its own table: London, Madrid, Dubai and more. Which tables have you unlocked?

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: 8-ball pool'da oq shar bilan birga nechta shar bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many balls are used in 8-ball pool, including the cue ball?

explanation.uz: 15 ta rangli shar va 1 ta oq shar: jami 16 ta.
explanation.en: 15 object balls plus the cue ball: 16 in total.

uz:
🏆 Kunlik kubok turnirlari
Kuniga 4 marta turnir ochiladi: Morning, Noon, Evening va Night Cup. Qatnashing va kubok yuting!
en:
🏆 Daily cup tournaments
A tournament opens 4 times a day: Morning, Noon, Evening and Night Cup. Join and win cups!

uz:
🎱 Kiylar to'plami
Oddiy kiylardan premium kiylargacha: har birining o'z kuchi bor. O'z kolleksiyangizni yig'ing!
en:
🎱 Cue collection
From simple cues to premium ones, each with its own power. Build your own collection!

poll.uz: Qaysi o'yin rejimi sizga ko'proq yoqadi?
poll.en: Which game mode do you like most?
options: Do'stlar bilan lobbi / Lobby with friends

quiz.en: Quiz: when do you pocket the black 8-ball?
options: O'z guruhingizdagi hamma sharni tushirgach / After all balls of your group
Raqibning sharlaridan keyin / After the opponent's balls

explanation.uz: Avval o'z guruhingizni (1–7 yoki 9–15) tushirasiz, keyin 8-sharni.
explanation.en: First clear your own group (1–7 or 9–15), then pocket the 8.

uz:
🎡 Omad g'ildiragi
Har 24 soatda bitta bepul aylantirish: tangalar, olmos, naqd pul va boshqa sovg'alar.
en:
🎡 Lucky wheel
One free spin every 24 hours: coins, gems, cash and other gifts.

uz:
🎁 Kunlik sovg'alar yo'li
Har kuni o'yinga kiring va sovg'a oling. Ketma-ket kirgan sari sovg'alar kattalashadi.
en:
🎁 Daily reward route
Open the game every day and collect a gift. The more days in a row, the bigger the gifts.

quiz.en: Quiz: which numbered balls are called 'stripes'?

uz:
💡 Maslahat: aniq zarba
1) Nishon chizig'ini sharga to'g'rilang.
2) Kuchni me'yorida tanlang: ortiqcha kuch oq sharni ham yo'qotishi mumkin.
3) Sinov o'yinida (Practice) tinch mashq qiling.
en:
💡 Tip: a clean shot
1) Line the aim guide up with the ball.
2) Pick a moderate power: too much force can lose the cue ball too.
3) Practice calmly in the Practice game.

uz:
🎮 Mini-o'yinlar
Spin & Win, Lucky Shot, Golden Shot, Scratch & Win va Surprise Boxes: asosiy o'yin orasida dam olish uchun.
en:
🎮 Minigames
Spin & Win, Lucky Shot, Golden Shot, Scratch & Win and Surprise Boxes: a break between the main games.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: qoida buzilgandan (foul) keyin raqib odatda nima oladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what does the opponent usually get after a foul?
options: Oq sharni xohlagan joyga qo'yish / Ball in hand
Navbat o'tmaydi / The same turn again

explanation.uz: Raqib oq sharni stolning xohlagan joyiga qo'yib uradi (ball in hand).
explanation.en: The opponent places the cue ball anywhere and shoots (ball in hand).

uz:
⚡ Maxsus tadbirlar
Grandmaster Table, Showdown, King's Gambit va boshqa tadbirlar: o'zingizni sinab ko'ring!
en:
⚡ Special events
Grandmaster Table, Showdown, King's Gambit and more: test yourself!

uz:
🩸 Mavsum yo'li (Season Pass)
O'yinlarda g'alaba qozonib, vazifalarni bajaring va mukofotlarni oching.
en:
🩸 Season Pass
Win matches, complete missions and unlock the rewards.

quiz.uz: 🎡 Viktorina: o'yinda omad g'ildiragini necha soatda bir marta bepul aylantirish mumkin?
quiz.en: Quiz: how often can you spin the lucky wheel for free in the game?

explanation.uz: Har 24 soatda bitta bepul aylantirish bor.
explanation.en: There is one free spin every 24 hours.

uz:
🎮 Hammasi bir joyda
1 vs 1, 16–64 o'yinchilik kubok, tadbirlar, mini-o'yinlar va do'st bilan o'yin. Telegram'da, bepul.
en:
🎮 Everything in one place
1 vs 1, cups for 16–64 players, events, minigames and a game with a friend. In Telegram, free to play.

quiz.uz: 🏆 Viktorina: kunlik kubok turnirlari kuniga necha marta ochiladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many times a day do the daily cup tournaments open?

explanation.uz: Morning, Noon, Evening va Night Cup: kuniga 4 marta.
explanation.en: Morning, Noon, Evening and Night Cup: 4 times a day.

text.uz:
🎙 Ovozli chat bilan o'ynang
8 kishigacha lobbi: do'stlaringizni havola bilan taklif qiling va o'yin vaqtida jonli gaplashing.
text.en:
🎙 Play with voice chat
A lobby for up to 8 players: invite your friends with a link and talk live while you play.

text.uz:
🙏 Kanalga obuna bo'lganingiz uchun rahmat!
O'yin sizga yoqdimi? Savol yoki taklifingiz bo'lsa, shu yerda yozing. Hammasini o'qiymiz.
text.en:
🙏 Thank you for subscribing!
Do you like the game? If you have a question or an idea, write it here. We read everything.

text.uz:
💡 Maslahat: xayoliy shar
Sharni cho'ntakka yo'naltirish uchun uning orqasida xayoliy shar tasavvur qiling: oq shar shu xayoliy sharning o'rniga kelsa, nishon shar cho'ntak tomon ketadi.
text.en:
💡 Tip: the ghost ball
To send a ball into a pocket, picture a 'ghost ball' right behind it: when the cue ball arrives at that spot, the object ball heads for the pocket.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: standart pul stolining uzunligi eniga nisbatan necha barobar?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many times longer than its width is a standard pool table?

explanation.en: The length is twice the width (2:1).

text.uz:
🎯 Mashq qiling
O'yinda «Mashq» rejimi bor: istalgancha urishingiz va yangi zarbalarni sinab ko'rishingiz mumkin. Qiyin zarbani avval shu yerda o'rganing.
text.en:
🎯 Practice makes perfect
There is a Practice mode in the game: shoot as much as you like and try out new shots. Learn a hard shot there first.

poll.en: Which table do you like most?

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: pul stolida nechta cho'ntak bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many pockets does a pool table have?

explanation.uz: 6 ta: to'rtta burchakda va ikkitasi uzun tomonlar o'rtasida.
explanation.en: 6: four in the corners and two in the middle of the long sides.

text.uz:
📐 Bortdan zarba
Sharni bortga (devorga) urganda u taxminan kirgan burchagi bilan qaytadi. Bortdan o'tadigan zarbani oldindan shu burchak bilan rejalashtiring.
text.en:
📐 Bank shots
A ball bounces off the cushion at about the same angle it came in. Plan a bank shot ahead of time with that angle in mind.

text.uz:
🌍 O'yin 14 tilda
O'zbekcha, English, Русский, Türkçe, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, हिन्दी, 한국어, 日本語 va 中文. Tilni Sozlamalar bo'limida o'zgartiring.
text.en:
🌍 14 languages
O'zbekcha, English, Русский, Türkçe, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, हिन्दी, 한국어, 日本語 and 中文. Change the language in Settings.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: boshlang'ich zarbada 15 shar qanday shaklda teriladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: in what shape are the 15 balls racked for the break?

explanation.en: In a triangle, with the 8-ball in the middle of it.

text.uz:
🏆 Kunlik reja
1) Kunlik sovg'ani oling.
2) Omad g'ildiragini aylantiring.
3) Omadli zarbani urib ko'ring.
4) Kunlik kubok turnirlaridan biriga qatnashing.
Hammasi bepul boshlanadi!
text.en:
🏆 Your daily routine
1) Collect the daily gift.
2) Spin the lucky wheel.
3) Try the Lucky Shot.
4) Join one of the daily cup tournaments.
It all starts for free!

text.uz:
📱 Telefonni qanday ushlash kerak?
Telefon tik tursa ham o'yin stolni o'zi buradi, qo'lingizni burishingiz shart emas. Qulay tutib o'ynang.
text.en:
📱 How to hold your phone
Even when the phone is upright the game turns the table for you, so there is no need to rotate it. Just hold it comfortably.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: oq shar cho'ntakka tushib ketsa nima deyiladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is it called when the cue ball falls into a pocket?

explanation.uz: Scratch: oq sharning cho'ntakka tushishi. Bu qoida buzilishi hisoblanadi.
explanation.en: A scratch: the cue ball is pocketed. It counts as a foul.

text.uz:
🛡 Himoyaviy o'yin
Har doim qiyin zarbani urish shart emas. Ba'zan raqibga noqulay holat qoldirib, oq sharni uning sharlaridan yashirish yaxshiroq (bu «safety» deyiladi).
text.en:
🛡 Playing safe
You do not have to take every hard shot. Sometimes it is better to leave your opponent in a bad spot and hide the cue ball behind your opponent's balls (this is called a 'safety').

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: kiy uchiga surtiladigan ko'k modda nima?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the blue substance rubbed on the cue tip?

explanation.uz: Bo'r kiy uchining oq sharda sirpanishini kamaytiradi.
explanation.en: Chalk helps the tip grip the cue ball instead of slipping.

text.uz:
🏅 Haftalik reyting
Har hafta dushanba kuni (UTC 00:00) reyting yopiladi, eng yaxshilar mukofot oladi va yangi hafta boshlanadi. Reytingdagi o'rningizni Reyting bo'limidan ko'ring.
text.en:
🏅 Weekly ranking
Every Monday (00:00 UTC) the ranking closes, the best players get rewards and a new week begins. Check your place in the Ranking section.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: oq sharning pastki qismiga urilsa u qanday aylanadi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what spin does the cue ball get if it is hit below the center?

explanation.uz: Pastga urilsa oq shar orqaga tortiladi (draw): nishon sharga tekkach orqaga qaytishi mumkin.
explanation.en: Hit low and the cue ball draws back: after striking the object ball it can roll backwards.

text.uz:
🏘 Klub tuzing
6-darajaga yetgach klub tuzishingiz yoki mavjud klubga qo'shilishingiz mumkin. Klubda 50 kishigacha bo'ladi. Haftalik klublar reytingining eng yaxshi uchtasi mukofot oladi.
text.en:
🏘 Join a club
From level 6 you can create a club or join an existing one. A club holds up to 50 members, and the three best clubs of the week get rewards.

text.uz:
🔔 Bildirishnomalar
Bot sizga o'yin haqida eslatma yuborishi mumkin. Istamasangiz, botga /stop deb yozing yoki Sozlamalarda o'chirib qo'ying.
text.en:
🔔 Notifications
The bot may send you reminders about the game. If you do not want them, send /stop to the bot or switch them off in Settings.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: yon aylanish (side spin) ingliz tilida nima deyiladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is side spin called in English?

explanation.en: In cue sports, side spin is known as 'English'.

text.uz:
👀 Tomosha rejimi
Ustalarning jonli o'yinini kuzatib, ularning zarbalaridan o'rganing. Tomosha bo'limida «JONLI» belgisi bor o'yinlarni toping.
text.en:
👀 Watch mode
Watch live games of strong players and learn from their shots. Find the matches marked LIVE in the Watch section.

quiz.uz: 🌆 Viktorina: o'yinda nechta shahar stoli bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many city tables are there in the game?

explanation.uz: 30 shahar, har birining o'z stoli bor.
explanation.en: 30 cities, each with its own table.

text.uz:
🎯 Omadli zarba yangilandi
Endi sharlar va nishon har safar boshqa joyda chiqadi, ba'zan nishon yaqinida ikkita shar ham bo'ladi. Har kuni bepul urinish bor!
text.en:
🎯 Lucky Shot has been updated
The balls and the target now land in a different place every time, and sometimes there are two balls near the target. There is a free try every day!

quiz.uz: 🎙 Viktorina: ovozli chatli lobbida eng ko'pi bilan necha kishi o'ynay oladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many players can be in one lobby with voice chat?

explanation.uz: Lobbi 8 kishigacha: do'stlaringizni havola bilan taklif qiling.
explanation.en: A lobby holds up to 8 players: invite your friends with a link.

poll.en: Who do you like to play with?

text.uz:
🤝 Do'stingizni taklif qiling
O'yin ichida do'stingizga havola yuboring: birga o'ynash yanada qiziqarli. Do'stlar bo'limida ularning onlayn holatini ko'rasiz.
text.en:
🤝 Invite a friend
Send your friend a link from inside the game: playing together is more fun. In the Friends section you can see who is online.

quiz.en: Quiz: which of these is NOT among the game's minigames?

explanation.uz: Mini-o'yinlar: Spin & Win, Lucky Shot, Golden Shot, Scratch & Win va Surprise Boxes.
explanation.en: The minigames are Spin & Win, Lucky Shot, Golden Shot, Scratch & Win and Surprise Boxes.

text.uz:
💪 Zarba kuchi
Har zarbani to'liq kuch bilan urish shart emas. Kuchli zarba oq sharni boshqarishni qiyinlashtiradi; o'rtacha kuch ko'pincha aniqroq natija beradi.
text.en:
💪 Shot power
You do not have to hit every shot at full power. A hard hit makes the cue ball harder to control; a medium power often gives a more accurate result.

quiz.en: Quiz: how many leagues are there in the game?

explanation.uz: Bronzadan eng yuqori ligagacha 10 ta liga bor. Haftalik reytingda yuqoriga ko'tariling.
explanation.en: There are 10 leagues, from Bronze up to the top one. Climb them in the weekly ranking.

text.uz:
🥇 Hafta natijalari kanalda
Har hafta yopilgach eng yaxshi uchlik shu kanalda e'lon qilinadi. Ismingiz chiqishini xohlasangiz, Sozlamalarda «Kanalda ismimni ko'rsatish» ni yoqing. Yoqmasangiz, «bir o'yinchi» deb yoziladi.
text.en:
🥇 Weekly results in the channel
When a week closes, the top three are announced here. To have your name shown, switch on 'Show my name in the channel' in Settings. Otherwise it says 'a player'.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: 8-ball'da o'z sharingizni to'g'ri tushirsangiz, keyingi zarba kimda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in 8-ball, who shoots next after you pocket one of your balls legally?

explanation.uz: To'g'ri shar tushirsangiz, navbat sizda qoladi va yana urasiz.
explanation.en: Pocket a legal ball and you keep the turn and shoot again.

poll.en: What would you like to see in the next update?

text.uz:
🔁 Oq sharning keyingi o'rni
Zarba urishdan oldin oq shar qayerda to'xtashini o'ylang. Yaxshi o'yinchi bitta sharni emas, ikkita-uchta zarbani oldindan rejalaydi.
text.en:
🔁 Where does the cue ball end up?
Before you shoot, think about where the cue ball will stop. A good player plans two or three shots ahead, not just one.

text.uz:
🎁 Kunlik sovg'alar yo'li
Har kuni kirsangiz, sovg'a kattalashib boradi. Bir kun o'tkazib yuborsangiz ham, keyingi kun yana davom eting.
text.en:
🎁 Daily gift route
The more days you open the game, the bigger the gifts get. If you miss a day, simply carry on the next one.

text.uz:
🌀 Aylanish (spin)
O'yinda oq sharga aylanish berish mumkin: pastga, yuqoriga yoki yonga. Mashq rejimida sinab ko'ring va oq shar zarbadan keyin qanday yurishini kuzating.
text.en:
🌀 Spin
You can put spin on the cue ball in the game: low, high or to the side. Try it in Practice mode and watch how the cue ball moves after the shot.

quiz.uz: 🤖 Viktorina: botda bildirishnomalarni o'chirish uchun qaysi buyruq yoziladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: which command do you send to the bot to stop notifications?

explanation.uz: /stop yozsangiz bot sizga eslatma yubormaydi. Qayta yoqish uchun botda /start yozing.
explanation.en: Send /stop and the bot will not send you reminders. Send /start to get them again.

poll.uz: O'yinda sizga eng ko'p nima yoqadi?
poll.en: What do you like most in the game?
options: Klublar va do'stlar / Clubs and friends

text.uz:
📅 Kanal haqida
Bu kanalda har kuni bitta post chiqadi: o'yin maslahatlari, viktorinalar, so'rovnomalar va yangiliklar. Do'stlaringizni ham obuna bo'lishga chaqiring!
text.en:
📅 About this channel
One post a day: game tips, quizzes, polls and news. Invite your friends to subscribe too!

text.uz:
🙋 Savollaringiz bormi?
O'yin yoki kanal haqida savol, taklif yoki xatolik haqida shu kanalda izoh qoldiring. Hammasini o'qiymiz va javob beramiz.
text.en:
🙋 Any questions?
Leave a comment in this channel with a question, an idea or a bug report about the game. We read everything and we reply.
